from datetime import datetime

def parse_year(dt_str):
    if not dt_str:
        return None
    try:
        return datetime.fromisoformat(dt_str.replace('Z','+00:00')).year
    except Exception:
        try:
            return int(dt_str[:4])
        except Exception:
            return None

# Re-fetch current library songs
current_library_songs=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page=apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    current_library_songs.extend(page)
    page_index+=1

current_library_song_ids=set([s['song_id'] for s in current_library_songs])
print('current_library_songs_count', len(current_library_songs), 'unique_song_ids', len(current_library_song_ids), 'pages', page_index)

# Determine which remaining library songs have release year<=2021
lib_songs_le_2021=set()
lib_song_years={}
for sid in current_library_song_ids:
    info=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    y=parse_year(info.get('release_date'))
    lib_song_years[sid]=y
    if y is not None and y<=2021:
        lib_songs_le_2021.add(sid)
print('library_songs_with_release_year<=2021', len(lib_songs_le_2021))

# Re-fetch current playlists
current_playlists=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page=apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    current_playlists.extend(page)
    page_index+=1

print('current_playlists_count', len(current_playlists), 'pages', page_index)

# Determine any playlist songs with release year<=2021
playlist_songs_le_2021=set()
playlist_song_years={}
for p in current_playlists:
    for sid in p.get('song_ids',[]):
        if sid in playlist_song_years:
            continue
        info=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
        y=parse_year(info.get('release_date'))
        playlist_song_years[sid]=y
        if y is not None and y<=2021:
            playlist_songs_le_2021.add(sid)

print('playlist_unique_song_ids_with_release_year<=2021', len(playlist_songs_le_2021))
# Also show if any of those were supposed removed
print('overlap_with_original_songs_to_remove', len(playlist_songs_le_2021 & songs_to_remove))
# show sample remaining violating songs if any
sample_violating=list(sorted(playlist_songs_le_2021))[:10]
print('sample_playlist_violating_song_ids', sample_violating)
if sample_violating:
    print('sample_playlist_violating_details', [(sid, playlist_song_years[sid]) for sid in sample_violating])

# criteria
criteria_met = (len(lib_songs_le_2021)==0 and len(playlist_songs_le_2021)==0)
print('criteria_met', criteria_met)
